notes: Do not use hiit_partition_mode=task_only for confirmatory pairing.
PH and PS remain separate session_id values; never pool across protocols.

duration_gates.note: D240 and D180 must be eligible (or explicitly not_supplied with stop). Missing duration support is a blocker, not exclusion.

eeg.verify: M3 multitaper QC must retain EEG channels after bad-channel rejection; empty clean set is a stop.

stop_if: raw_root missing or observation discovery raises FileNotFoundError
any selected participant lacks a complete PRE rest-Tetris pair within a session
any selected participant lacks a complete POST rest-Tetris pair within a session
cardiac channel used is not photosensor (or inferred type is not ppg)
Stage-1b inventory shows no photosensor/optical PPG candidate
clean_beat_span_s or overlap cannot support D240 (and nested D180) for paired observations intended for ZLPI
eligibility status is ineligible due to insufficient duration OR not_computable due to unknown timing while raw was expected
paired_subject_sets show n_paired=0 for a contrast that was required for the smoke subset
never_do: Interpret missing raw files / missing sessions as participant exclusion
Collapse PH and PS into task_only pre_rest/pre_tetris labels for confirmatory endpoints
Switch primary cardiac channel to ECG for this PPG smoke without reissuing verification
unresolved_assumptions: Eye-state and posture instructions remain unverified from adapters.
Whether PS (pressure-protocol) recordings always contain a usable photosensor PPG channel must be verified in Stage-1b inventory; stop if not.
Exact photosensor channel label spelling may vary (photosensor vs Photosensor); selection must resolve to PPG signal_type.
Participants 01–03 completeness on disk must be confirmed by the operator before Stage 0.
